name: Sunken Treasure
summary: After the previous step in the Sunken Treasure chain, Shakes O'Breen is stuck where he is and needs word taken to Fleet Master Seahorn at Booty Bay. He asks you to carry a sample gem as proof of the find.

sections.title: Word for Booty Bay
sections.body: Shakes O'Breen wants Fleet Master Seahorn to hear of the find right away, yet he cannot easily get away. The tide is too low, and the creatures they disturbed are watching every move. He asks you to help the Blackwater Raiders by telling Seahorn in Booty Bay that the treasure is found and more is being brought up. A sample elven gem goes with you as proof.

faq.q: Why can't Shakes O'Breen deliver the gem himself?
aliases: why does shakes need a courier
faq.answer: The tide is too low for them to get away, and the creatures they disturbed are keeping a close eye on their movements.
He is the Fleet Master in Booty Bay, whom O'Breen wants to hear of the find at once.

faq.q: What proof is being carried to Booty Bay?
faq.answer: A sample elven gem, which shows that the treasure was found and that more is being extracted.
